capabilities: : Filter results by path or extension
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Native Search trades relevance ranking and typo tolerance for a minimal in-app footprint.
motivation: The author built it to provide a low-footprint search solution for large or document-heavy vaults by leveraging the existing OS index instead of building an internal one.
problem: Traditional in-app search engines require building and maintaining a large internal index, which increases startup time, memory usage, and scaling issues in very large vaults.
summary: Native Search provides zero-index search for Obsidian, leveraging the OS-native index (like macOS Spotlight) to search PDFs, images, and Office documents without building an internal index.
